needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this location to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait before crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair users and others to access the footway.
Install street lighting along this rural road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.
